description: The file defines a Flutter widget, DashboardPage, which displays high-level task statistics including cards, distribution bars, and progress indicators. It imports Flutter material widgets, Firestore database, provider for dependency injection, and a custom DashboardService. The file includes several stateless and stateful widgets to construct the dashboard UI, handle stream data, and visualize statistics.
